excerpt.zh: 并非其“母星”的原住民，这些石质生物随一颗坠入该行星的陨石到来，同时杀死了大多数土著生命。
excerpt.en: Not native to their 'homeworld', these Lithoids arrived when a meteorite slammed into the planet and killed off most of the native life.

texts.zh: 并非其“母星”的原住民，这些石质生物随一颗坠入该行星的陨石到来，同时杀死了大多数土著生命。
texts.en: Not native to their 'homeworld', these Lithoids arrived when a meteorite slammed into the planet and killed off most of the native life.

sections.zh:
尽管关于我们的起源（肇始）无处可寻，可以确定的是我们那尚未开智的先祖们是随着一颗庞大的陨石来到[GetHomeWorldName]的，陨石撞击带来了烈焰与灾难，星球上的土著居民大多未能幸免。

千万年已经过去，最初的[GetSpeciesName]逐渐遍布[GetHomeWorldName]全球，不断进化，繁衍生息。我们的文明不断传播并走向繁荣，随着[GetStartingDrive]的发明，我们已准备好探索这片星海。
sections.en:
While our true origins are unknown, we do know that our presapient ancestors arrived on a vast meteorite which slammed into [GetHomeWorldName] in a fiery cataclysm and wiped out most of the native inhabitants.

In the eons since, the first primitive [GetSpeciesName] spread out over [GetHomeWorldName], evolved, and multiplied. Our civilization has spread and prospered, and with the invention of the [GetStartingDrive] we stand ready to explore the galaxy.
